costBasisOverride.tooltip: The cost you enter instead of the weighted average cost: for Exit Tax, inheritance or special fiscal rules. Auto calculates it from your purchases. Use the Total/Per unit toggle below to choose how this amount is entered.
costBasisOverride.warningAdjustment: The manual cost basis is empty: the transaction can't be saved without it. Enter what these units cost you: 0 for the new shares of a stock split. For a gift, enter 0, or what the donor paid for them: that keeps the weighted average cost, and the gain you may be taxed on, closer to the real ones.
costBasisOverride.rewardTooltip: What these units were worth on the day you received them: it is both the income of the reward and the cost of the lot it opens.
costBasisOverride.warningReward: The value on receipt is empty: the reward can't be saved without it. Enter what these units were worth on the day you received them, or 0 to count them at no cost.
costBasisOverride.rewardFromHistory: From the price history: the close of {date}. Change it if the platform shows another value.

errors.integerDigitsExceeded: At most {max} digits before the decimal point

errors.autoCostUnknownPool: Automatic cost unavailable: the units of this asset held on that date have no known cost to average. Choose Manual and enter what these units cost you.

errors.pairCurrencyMismatch: Both sides of a cash transfer must be in the same currency (found {currencyA} and {currencyB}). To change currency, use a currency exchange
errors.pairAmountMismatch: A cash transfer must take out of one broker the same amount it brings into the other (found {amountA} and {amountB})
errors.pairCurrencySame: The two sides of a currency exchange must be in different currencies (both are {currency})

errors.chargeAssetMissing: This charge has no asset and its transaction has one: clone the charge with that asset, then link the copy.

errors.chargesBlockParentType: This transaction has linked charges, and a {type} cannot have any: unlink them first.
errors.chargeRefDuplicate: The name '{ref}' is given to more than one row of this batch.
errors.chargeParentRefNotFound: No row of this batch is named '{parentRef}': the charge cannot be linked to it.
errors.chargeParentTwice: A charge names its transaction once: by the row of this batch or by a saved transaction, not both.
errors.chargeParentIdInvalid: The transaction a charge is linked to must be a saved transaction (a positive id).
errors.chargesDeleteIncomplete: This transaction has linked charges: delete them or unlink them in the same change.
errors.costBasisAutoNotAllowed: ❌ {type} takes its value on receipt as its cost basis, never the average cost: no Auto mode, enter the value.
